description: This file defines a class SuppressExceptions for optional error handling in the PDFsharp library, along with some experimental error handling interfaces and structs under conditional compilation.

classes.name: SuppressExceptions
classes.description: Provides a mechanism to handle errors without throwing exceptions, by setting an ErrorOccurred flag.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles an error by setting ErrorOccurred to true if suppressExceptions is not null; otherwise, calls the provided throwException action.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the suppressExceptions instance has encountered an error.
